name: the-optimal-twerking-video
why: Opens on a phone the size of a monolith with sixteen billion transistors; it A/B tests two twerkers while the budget's testing bar is a stamp-sized stub, the bomb tap gushes, and 55,000,000 skeletons climb out of their graves to do the optimized twerk.

name: nixon-fires-at-the-dope
why: Opens on "Or consider the War on Drugs" as Nixon's tank fires at a bag of dope that doubles; headstones climb from 6,000 to 100,000 past an unplugged Optimitron, and the answer to 18 times worse is a bigger budget whose recoil knocks Nixon off his podium.

name: vending-machine-democracy
why: Opens on the Capitol as a vending machine where a lobbyist's quarter buys a sofa of money; then the heist on five buildings that hate each other ends with every window a spotlight on him: the plot of a movie where the criminals lose.
